# Shaiv Market

> Shaiv Market is the practice of Chirag Sharma, an AMFI registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-337289, EUIN E641362, NISM Series V-A certified) based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It helps individuals and families plan SIPs and life goals, reviews existing portfolios for free, and opens mutual fund accounts with paperless KYC for investors anywhere in India.

Key facts:
- Name: Shaiv Market (shaivmarket.com)
- Founder: Chirag Sharma, AMFI Registered Mutual Fund Distributor
- AMFI ARN: ARN-337289, valid 18 Aug 2025 to 13 Aug 2028. Verify at https://www.amfiindia.com/locate-distributor
- EUIN: E641362
- Certification: NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), valid until 13 Aug 2028
- Office: 6th Floor, Bhamashah Techno Hub, Jhalana Doongari, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302004, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99506 53247
- Email: marketlive45@gmail.com
- Serves: Jaipur in person; all of India online (video, phone, WhatsApp)
- Fees: first portfolio review call is free; as a distributor, Shaiv Market is paid commission by fund houses on regular plans, with no separate advisory fee
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Services
- Free portfolio review
- SIP planning and setup, including step-up SIPs
- Goal-based planning: child education, home down payment, retirement
- Retirement income through SWP (systematic withdrawal plans)
- Paperless KYC and mutual fund account opening
- Yearly portfolio review and rebalancing

## Guides (blog)
- [Child Education Planning: How Much SIP for Your Child's College?](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/child-education-sip-plan): How to plan your child's higher education with a SIP. Estimate the future cost with education inflation, find the monthly amount, see the cost of starting late, and protect the money in the final years.
- [Direct vs Regular Mutual Funds: An Honest Answer from a Distributor](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/direct-vs-regular-mutual-fund): What separates direct and regular mutual fund plans, how much the expense ratio gap costs over 20 years, and when paying for a distributor is worth it, written by an AMFI registered MFD.
- [ELSS in 2026: Does It Still Save You Tax? (Old vs New Regime, Section 123)](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/elss-tax-saving-guide): 80C is now Section 123 under the Income-tax Act 2025. Find out if ELSS still saves you tax, who should use it, the 3-year lock-in, and a worked example for a ₹15 lakh salary.
- [Looking for a Mutual Fund Advisor in Jaipur? RIA or MFD, Explained](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/mutual-fund-advisor-in-jaipur): Searching for a mutual fund advisor in Jaipur? Know the difference between a SEBI registered investment adviser (RIA) and an AMFI registered mutual fund distributor (MFD), what each costs, and which one you need.
- [Mutual Fund Distributor in Jaipur: How to Choose One You Can Trust](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/mutual-fund-distributor-in-jaipur): What a mutual fund distributor (MFD) in Jaipur actually does, what it costs you, how to verify an ARN, and the questions to ask before you hand over your SIPs.
- [Mutual Fund KYC in 2026: Documents, Steps and How to Fix "On Hold"](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/mutual-fund-kyc-documents): The documents you need for mutual fund KYC, how to complete it on your phone in ten minutes, what Validated, Registered and On Hold mean, and how to fix a KYC that's stuck.
- [How Much SIP Do You Need for ₹1 Crore? (10, 15, 20 and 25 Years)](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/sip-for-1-crore): The exact monthly SIP needed to reach ₹1 crore in 10, 15, 20 or 25 years at 10% and 12%, how a yearly step-up cuts the starting amount, and what ₹1 crore will really be worth.
- [SIP vs FD: What ₹10,000 a Month Becomes in 10 Years (After Tax)](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/sip-vs-fd): A side-by-side, after-tax comparison of a ₹10,000 monthly SIP and a recurring deposit over 10 years, with the real reasons to choose one, the other, or both.
- [SWP for Retirement: How to Turn ₹50 Lakh into a Monthly Pension](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/swp-for-monthly-pension): How a systematic withdrawal plan (SWP) works, how long ₹50 lakh lasts at ₹25,000 to ₹40,000 a month, why you must plan for rising expenses, and how SWP income is taxed.
- [How to Verify a Mutual Fund Distributor's ARN in 2 Minutes](https://shaivmarket.com/blog/verify-mutual-fund-distributor-arn): Before you invest through anyone, check their ARN on the AMFI website. Here's exactly how, what to look for, the red flags, and how to confirm your money reached the fund house.
